en.html:
Kill Kanae Ootori.
...I had killed her.

My heart was pounding. Not from killing her. Killing did not fill my heart with life. It froze it. All I could do was shiver in that cold.

What had set my heart racing was the killing intent I had met.
The will to take my life—and the act that followed it.

The instant I attacked from above and behind, she had sensed the danger herself. Nobody to warn her, nobody to help. She drew and fired one shot.

As if she had known something would happen.
The long gun was loaded already. Even seeing an attacker she ought to recognise had not shaken her.

Now she lay dead. And still, on that face, no doubt.

Only resignation.
The face of somebody who knew she had fought and lost.

A soldier's face.

ja.html:
大鳥香奈枝を殺す。
　……殺した。

　動悸が激しい。
　殺した事によるものとは違う――殺害感触は心臓に
活力など与えない。むしろ氷結させ、俺はその冷たさ
に<ruby>慄<rt>ふる</rt></ruby>えるだけだ。

　鼓動が早められているのは殺意に接したためだった。
　己の命を脅かす意思。そしてその実象化。

　上空、後背からの襲撃の瞬間。
　彼女は単身、誰にも頼らず凶気を察し、抜き撃ちに
一弾を放ってみせたのだ。

　まるで、事ある時を予知していたかのように。
　長銃には<ruby>予<rt>あらかじ</rt></ruby>め弾丸を装填して。
　襲撃者の、覚えがあろう姿を見ても動じることなく。

　今は斃され。
　命を喪失している彼女の相貌に、やはり疑念を示す
ものはない。

　あるのは諦念。
　戦い、敗北したことを知った表情。
　
　兵士の顔だった。

en.html:
I understood.

She had not trusted me.

She had seen through my lies.
She had seen the truth of me.

Then why...
Why had she been killed?

Why had she let me kill her?

She should have been able to kill me. She could have done it!
If she had not trusted me, then she could have!

Why—

No. Surely not.

Was it that she had wanted to trust me?

...I did not know.
Kanae Ootori was not going to answer any more questions of mine.

I could only look down at her body.
The woman I must not lose, I had lost. That fact filled me with terror.

ja.html:
悟った。

　――彼女は俺を信じていなかった。

　俺の欺瞞を見破り、
　真実を見てくれていた。

　なのに、なぜ……
　殺されてしまったのだろう。

　なぜ、<ruby>殺すことを許した<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>のだろう。

　彼女は俺を殺し得た筈。
　できた筈だ。俺を信じていなかったのなら！

　なぜ――
　
　――まさか、

　<ruby>信じたかった<rt>・・・・・・</rt></ruby>とでもいうのだろうか。

　……わからない。
　もはや大鳥香奈枝は俺の疑問に答えない。

　俺はただ彼女の骸を見下ろし、
　失ってはならぬ<ruby>女<rt>ひと</rt></ruby>を失った事実に恐怖するばかりだ。
